name: manual_5b6518
claim: Local qwen3.8-27b on LM Studio (8192-token context, about 6 to 9 tokens per second) is not usable for code generation: four small pieces (prompts under 1000 tokens, max_tokens 5600) each ended finish_reason=length with all tokens spent on reasoning and no code in 13 minutes per piece; write code directly and keep the model for short bounded advisory questions unless the loaded context and output budget are raised.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-10 AR-WIN-1 attempt: round 1 (5900-token prompt) and round 2 (four pieces) produced zero code; the hand-written module passed 60 tests.

rationale: 2026-11-10 AR-WIN-1 attempt: round 1 (5900-token prompt) and round 2 (four pieces) produced zero code; the hand-written module passed 60 tests.
